description.zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，工作流任务需要处于以下状态：
- Initialized：初始化完成
- Terminated：已终止
- Succeeded：成功
- Failed：失败
descriptions.en:
When you call this API operation, the pipeline job must be in the following states:

*   Initialized
*   Terminated
*   Succeeded
*   Failed
